title: Pirate Water Taxi

services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: Feel free to board at any of our 10 stops on the Hillsborough River and Tampa Bay! Our ticket booth is located at our main dock at Stop 7. Annual Memberships do not guarantee Water Taxi admission, especially during high attendance periods. All boats first board guests with a wristband on a first-come, first-served basis, following all other guests in line on a first-come, first-served basis.
